purpose: React and Next.js performance patterns for existing code: eliminating waterfalls, cutting bundle size, RSC serialization, re-render and caching optimization.
use_when: Refactoring React or Next.js code to eliminate waterfalls with Promise.all, Suspense boundaries, and parallel data fetching
Optimizing bundle size by removing barrel imports and adding next/dynamic imports for heavy components
Reviewing React Server Components for serialization bloat, re-render memoization, and request caching issues
do_not_use_when: Designing a new landing page or app UI visual identity with typography and palette (use anthropic__frontend-design)
Building a high-density desktop dashboard with container queries and sidebar-adaptive layout (use local__desktop-dashboard-ui)
Scaffolding or bundling a multi-component claude.ai HTML artifact with React and shadcn (use anthropic__web-artifacts-builder)
scope: Only touch files the task names; everything else read-only.
disambiguator: Fixing performance of existing React code -> this. Doing visual/UI design for new or reshaped interfaces -> anthropic__frontend-design. Building dashboard grid systems -> local__desktop-dashboard-ui.
